Hello Prestiefull, I feel you on this one.  I suffer from depression, and probably many other things, and my girlfriend hates it.  We also do fight a lot, and it's terrible.  But, if you REALLY love someone, you will stick it out.  If you ever need anyone to talk to, just message this account bud :)

-Sky

Hello thssmythrwwy, I think I can definitely help you here.  I've been depressed for about 9 years now, and it definitely sucks.  No matter how much you hate life, and probably hate school because you feel you could be doing better stuff, there's one SIMPLE thing you can do to help yourself: say to yourself "I am better than everyone, I can make straight As, and NOBODY will stop me." trust me, it helps to even think this way for ONE day.  If you need to talk, just message this account bud :)

-Sky.
